The '''Morgukai Shadow Army''' was an alleged [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] project that was researched in the [[Saleucami Cloning Complex|secret labs]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]s [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Overview==
Seeking to establish a viable counter-measure to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone army]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] recruited one of the last remaining [[Morgukai]], [[Bok]], using him as the [[Clone template/Legends|template]] for a new clone army. [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]] was given control of this operation, with [[Tol Skorr]] operating as his [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. In addition to his role as the prime clone, [[Bok]] served as the primary training officer for the clones, tutoring the Shadow Army in [[Morgukai]] combat styles. To make them even deadlier, Bulq recruited [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin teachers]] from [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] to further train the [[Morgukai]] clones in the arts of stealth and assassination. The necessary [[Saleucami Cloning Complex|cloning facilities]] were constructed in the [[Magma Caverns|magma chambers]] beneath the capital city on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], also doubling as the training ground and all powered by the geothermal power stations also built into these catacombs. The clones and their instructors were all equipped with [[Cortosis/Legends|Cortosis]] alloy blades, to allow them to combat [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], though the source of these weapons is unknown. According to the assassin trainer [[Rath Kelkko]], the Morgukai clones adapted quickly to the Anzati methods and techniques, though he noted that proper mastery required years of training and practice.<ref name="Trackdown">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Trackdown]]''</ref>

==History==

=== Discovery ===
The Jedi Master [[Tholme/Legends]] and [[Aayla Secura]] led a recon expedition on [[Anzat]], as Sora Bulq had been seen often there. The master uncovered some clues about the Anzati scarcity of available trainers, and aayla fough and killed a lone clone, which she mistook for Bok itself. They also stole Sora Bulq's ships' records, identifying Salucami as the most visited planet. Aayla was send to another destiny, so Tholme went to Saleucami alone.[[File:Battle_of_Saleucami.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]].]]
Unfortunately for the Confederacy cause, Tholme managed to infiltrate into the cloning base and uncovered the Shadow Army's existence. Though he was found by Sora Bulq, he managed to warn the Republic of the threat before escaping. 

=== The Battle ===
Chancellor Palpatine decided than the Shadow Army was a threat to the Republic, and send several Jedi, leading three Clone battalions, to counter the threat. The Republic forces arrived before the Shadow Army could leave Saleucami. A [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|prolonged siege]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ensued, with both clone armies fighting for every meter of the ground, for five months, until the Republic forces finally get inside the besieged city.  Ironically, one of the Jedi leading them was also a [[Nikto]], [[Ausar Auset]], though he was killed during the assault of the city.

All that time, Tholme remained alive, sabotaging key systems of the Shadow Army base, and nobody was able to catch him. 

=== Annihilation ===
In a headhunter attack, all the Anzati instructors were killed by the Jedi commander, [[Oppo Rancisis]], before he was murdered by Sora Bulq. Finally, a Jedi infiltration team killed Boq, Skorr and Bulq, and blowed the base's magma conduits, while the Republic fleet bombarded the Separatist base, The magma erupotion and bombardment ended with the Shadow Army destruction, without any clone surviving.<ref name="The Siege of Saleucami">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Siege of Saleucami]]''</ref>
